decision.observation: Turn 15/500, 3440 BC. Choose Civic panel open on left. Code of Laws 'Just completed'. Two civic options visible: Craftsmanship (10 turns, 'Improve 3 tiles' boost condition) and Foreign Trade (10 turns, 'Discover a second continent' boost). Tooltip at bottom-right: 'You need to select a civic to progress toward.' Granary queued at 7 turns.
decision.hypothesis: Craftsmanship is the better choice right now - it unlocks Builder extra charges and has an achievable boost (improve 3 tiles). Foreign Trade requires discovering a second continent which is harder early. Click on Craftsmanship to select it.
